# Steven Jacobs

> Steven Jacobs is based in Austin, Texas. Family man, music industry, investor and real estate. This is his personal site: what he's working on and occasional writing.

## About

- Location: Austin, Texas, USA
- Focus: music industry, investing, real estate, small businesses
- X / Twitter: [@StevenJacobs](https://x.com/StevenJacobs)

## Projects

- [Rave Jesus](https://www.ravejesus.com/): Christian artist. Steven is part of the team.
- [Another Nine Pflugerville](https://anothernine.com/pages/austin-tx): 24/7 private indoor golf simulator suites. The Pflugerville, TX location is opening soon.
- [Beached Inn](https://beachedinn.com/): vacation rental in Port Aransas ("Port A"), Texas.
- Also building: an Amazon FBA store, apps, websites and YouTube channels.
